lines.japanese: ふう、ようやくバイトが終わった。
lines.english: Whew. My shift was finally over.

lines.japanese: だが、この程度じゃまだまだ署名は足りない。
lines.english: But we still did not have nearly enough signatures.

lines.japanese: 次は夜の街を巡回してしてみるか。協力してくれそうな連中がわんさかいるはずだ。
lines.english: Next, perhaps we should patrol the city by night. There ought to be hordes of people willing to help.

lines.japanese: さあ行くぞ、ロイヒテン・ギバラ！　柳木原の平和は私が守るだでー。
lines.english: Forward! Light upon Gibara! I’ll protect the peace of Yanagihara, y’know!
